### Notes

NOT INSPECTABLE: Ramp publishes no eligibility criteria on the startups page — no minimum bank balance, no US-entity requirement, no funding stage, no company age. Widely repeated third-party claims (e.g. a $75,000 minimum cash balance) appear only on aggregator sites and are NOT recorded here. The only conditional language on the page is "If your accelerator is a Ramp partner, you may already be pre-qualified", which describes pre-qualification rather than a gate. The perks are a partner marketplace, not Ramp credits: https://ramp.com/rewards states "Get Ramp today and redeem within the product dashboard", i.e. redemption requires an active Ramp account. The $350K figure is written on the page as "$350K+", a floor rather than a cap. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
